title: PluginManifest
description: Root configuration for an Aether plugin.

api.description: Integration with the host application API.

load.description: Defines how the plugin code should be loaded and executed.

runtime.description: Sandbox and security restrictions for the plugin.

features.description: List of optional host features requested by the plugin.

hostFunctions.description:
Host functions the plugin calls, by import name (`http_get`, `write_instance_file`, …).
Only these are linked into the plugin: a name the host does not know keeps the plugin
from being enabled, and a function the wasm imports without declaring it here keeps it
from loading. An empty list declares that the plugin calls none.
Required: a manifest without it is reported as incompatible.

oneOf.description: Use WebAssembly (Extism) for a secure, cross-platform sandbox.

file.description: Path to the .wasm file relative to the plugin root.

memoryLimit.description: Maximum memory (in bytes) the plugin is allowed to allocate.

PathMapping.description:
A mapping between a path on the host and a virtual path in the plugin.
Format: `[host_path, virtual_path]`

prefixItems.description: Virtual path inside the plugin sandbox.

description.description: Short summary of the plugin's purpose.

id.description: Unique identifier for the plugin (lowercase, kebab-case).

license.description: License under which the plugin is distributed.

allowedHosts.description: List of domains or IP addresses the plugin is allowed to connect to.

allowedPaths.description:
Ignored by the launcher, which logs a warning: folders are given to a plugin by the
user, in its settings. Kept so that manifests declaring it still load.
